definitions.explanation: Aquatic vertebrate animals that breathe through gills and typically have fins and scales. A biological classification group.

examples.japanese: {鮭|さけ}と{鯛|たい}は{魚類|ぎょるい}です。
examples.english: Salmon and sea bream are fish.

examples.japanese: {魚類|ぎょるい}は{鰓|えら}で{呼吸|こきゅう}します。
{海|うみ}には{多|おお}くの{魚類|ぎょるい}が{生息|せいそく}しています。
examples.english: Many species of fish inhabit the ocean.

notes:
{魚類|ぎょるい} is the scientific classification term for fish.

{魚|ぎょ} means "fish" and {類|るい} means "class/category."

Note: In everyday speech, {魚|さかな} is used. {魚類|ぎょるい} is more formal/scientific.

Types of fish:
- {淡水魚|たんすいぎょ} (freshwater fish)
- {海水魚|かいすいぎょ} (saltwater fish)
- {深海魚|しんかいぎょ} (deep-sea fish)

Related classification terms:
- {哺乳類|ほにゅうるい} (mammals)
- {爬虫類|はちゅうるい} (reptiles)
- {鳥類|ちょうるい} (birds)
